# Anthony Burton — Site Summary for AI Agents

## Who
Anthony Burton (also published as Anthony Glyn Burton). Postdoctoral researcher and lecturer in Critical Data & AI at the University of Amsterdam. Ph.D. in Communication from Simon Fraser University.

## What I Research
- Technofascism and Silicon Valley ideology
- Platform temporalities and algorithmic reason
- Mimesis, intelligence, and desire in late fascist politics
- Misinformation, disinformation, and algorithmic authenticity

## Key Work
- **Book:** *Algorithmic Authenticity* (meson press, 2023) — open access at https://meson.press/books/algorithmic-authenticity/
- **Dissertation:** *Fear of Mimesis: Technofascism and Intelligence in Silicon Valley*
- **Publications:** See /publications for refereed articles, book chapters, and reports.
